info.headline: Notify NYC - MTA Suspension - J Train Service
info.description:
Notification issued 10-05-2026 at 10:03 AM.
Due to EMS presence, J train service is suspended in both directions between Crescent Street and Broadway Junction. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info.
